annotations.title: Cancel a scheduled or live call

description:
Cancel a call that is scheduled or in progress (including a scheduled callback or automatic retry) and get the cancelled status back. Compliance: stops any further attempt to that number for this call; nothing is charged beyond the time already spoken.

    A live call is hung up immediately; only the time already spoken is paid and the reserved credit is released. A scheduled call will not be placed. Use it when the user changes their mind or the task is no longer needed. Cannot be undone. Cancelling an already cancelled call has no further effect; a call that already ended cannot be cancelled.

call_id.description: The call_id of the scheduled or live call to cancel.
